builds.name: Spiraling Despair: full damage and final burst
builds.summary: Investigate high one full Spiraling Despair duration and blast output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one full Spiraling Despair duration and blast output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: R deals 10/20/30 + 0.05 AP magic per second for three seconds, followed by 200/325/450 + 0.8 AP. Rank-3 nominal full duration is 540 + 0.95 AP before mitigation and actual tick boundaries. The quarter-second slow stacking is not a full damage-per-second packet at every slow tick.

ceiling.targetName: one full Spiraling Despair duration and blast

kitEvidence.formula:
Hwei launches a vision of pure despair that sticks to an enemy champion for [3] seconds. The vision expands over time applying a Slow to enemies for [10]% stacking every 0.25 seconds, and dealing [10 / 20 / 30 + (0.05) × AP] magic damage per second.

Upon completion, the vision shatters, dealing [200 / 325 / 450 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage.
